courseTitle: {to} pi jo ma loko Leb Acoli

s1.title: Cakke
s1.description: Moto, dano, cam, kwan wel, cawa, kabedo, gang ki yot kom.

s2.title: Kwo me nino ducu
s2.description: Tit jami, ruk, lok i kom nino ni, piny, lee, tic, cukul ki wot.

s3.title: Lok ki dano
s3.description: Kwer, peny lapeny, lok i kom gin ma okato ki ma bibino, kit ma iwinyo kwede, tuku, cim ki tedo.

s4.title: Kin dano ki kit kwo
s4.description: Kaka ki kwer, ker, pur, nino madito, wer, niye, cat ki wil ki lobo.

s5.title: Lalok ma ngeyo
s5.description: Por jami, par, lok lok, ti ki carolok, lub labaraka, ti ki peko me atura ki nyut woro.

cast.nakato: Lalwedi ni, latin kwan me yunivaciti i {@city}
cast.mukasa: Lapwony ma cwinye diyo ma oa ki {@hometown}
cast.ssali: Laryem boda boda ma ngeyo yo ducu
cast.amara: Latin kwan me cukul madit ma maro wer
cast.emma: Welo ma tye ka pwonye leb man ma peya owoto

u1.title: Moto
u1.description: Mot dano, tit nyingi ki kwan wel cito i apar.

u2.title: Dano ki jami
u2.description: Dog gang, jami me nino ducu ki lok tic mukwongo.

u3.title: Cam ki cuk
u3.description: Nying cam, wac ni kec tye ka neki, ki wil i cuk.

u4.title: Kwan wel ki cente
u4.description: Kwan wel cito i alip ki cul ki ciling.

u5.title: Cawa ki nino
u5.description: Lok i kom tin, nino me cabit ki cawa.

u6.title: Kabedo ki yo
u6.description: Nying kabedo i taun, wac ka ma icito iye ki nyut yo.

u7.title: Gang
u7.description: Ot ki jami ma iye, jolo welo ki kwayo jami.

u8.title: Yot kom ki kom dano
u8.description: Nying dul kom, wac gin ma lit ki neno daktar.

u9.title: Rangi ki tito jami
u9.description: Nying rangi ki tit jami ki dano.

u10.title: Ruk
u10.description: Nying ruk ni, ruk ki wil manyen.

u11.title: Nino na
u11.description: Lok i kom tic ni ma cakke odiko cito wa dyewor.

u12.title: Piny ki kare me mwaka
u12.description: Lok i kom ceng ki kot, kare me mwaka ki lyet onyo ngic.

u13.title: Lee
u13.description: Lee me gang, lee me tim, lee ma gipito ki owalo me Uganda.

u14.title: Tic
u14.description: Wac tic ma itiyo, peny i kom tic ki lok i kom mucara.

u15.title: Cukul
u15.description: Ot kwan, lok ma gipwonyo, lapeny ki tic me gang.

u16.title: Wot
u16.description: Nong takci onyo bac ki yub wot i Uganda.

u17.title: Kwero
u17.description: Wac gin ma pe imito, ma pe itye kwede ki ma pe ingeyo.

u18.title: Penyo lapeny
u18.description: Peny nga, ngo, kwene, awene ki pingo, ki peny i kom lok.

u19.title: Gin ma atimo
u19.description: Wac gin ma itimo tin, lawoo ki con.

u20.title: Yub
u20.description: Lok i kom diki, agiki cabit ki lek ni.

u21.title: Kit ma awinyo kwede
u21.description: Wac kit ma iwinyo kwede ki nyut ni iparo pi jo mukene.

u22.title: Tuku ki tuku odilo
u22.description: Lok i kom kare me yweyo, odilo, wer ki tuku.

u23.title: I cim
u23.description: Go cim, cwal kwena ki yub rwatte.

u24.title: Tedo
u24.description: Lub yo me tedo, ted dek ki nywak cam.

u25.title: Kaka ki kwer
u25.description: Pwonye i kom kaka me Buganda, kwer gi ki wac in nga.

u26.title: Ker
u26.description: Kabaka, gamente ne ki kabedo me te kwaro me Buganda.

u27.title: Paco ki pur
u27.description: Ti i poto, nying cam ma gipito ki kac.

u28.title: Nino madito
u28.description: Kwanjula, nyom, nino nywal ki mito ber pi dano.

u29.title: Wer ki myel
u29.description: Bul, wer ki myel, ki tito dano ki tic ma gitiyo.

u30.title: Niye ki nino madito
u30.description: Kabedo me lego, Bunyac, Id, Nino pa Lukaracwa ki gum.

u31.title: Cat ki wil
u31.description: Ti ki dukan matidi, kony luwil, gwok cente ki pwony jo mukene.

u32.title: Lobo
u32.description: Nam, kulu, tim ki got, ki gwoko lobo.

u33.title: Poro
u33.description: Wac gin ma dit kato, ma ber kato, ma rom onyo ma pat.

u34.title: Ka… ki kono…
u34.description: Lok i kom gin ma time ka…, ma kono bitime ka…, ki gin ma imito.

u35.title: Lok lok
u35.description: Cak lok, mede ki “ci” ki tyek lok.

u36.title: Carolok
u36.description: Pwonye carolok pa Baganda ma ngene, tyen lok gi ki kare me tic kwede.

u37.title: Labaraka ki kin dano
u37.description: Lub labaraka, lok i cokke ki mi tami.

u38.title: Peko me atura
u38.description: Lwong kony, ti ki peko me yo ki tit kwo.

u39.title: Woro ki kit maber
u39.description: Mot ludongo ki woro ki bed welo maber.

u40.title: Ododo
u40.description: Rwatte ki Wakayima apwoyo ki Kintu, ki wac pwony me ododo.
